name: join-text-composite-keys
description: Benchmark String and numeric composite join keys

queries.name: tier-and-id
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, b.country FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.tier = b.tier AND a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: country-and-id
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, b.tier FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.country = b.country AND a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: three-part-text
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, b.country FROM accounts a JOIN accounts b ON a.tier = b.tier AND a.country = b.country AND a.user_id = b.user_id ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20
